metadata.title: Kairox — Software development as a strategic decision
metadata.description: Technology partner for startups and companies: product design, web and mobile development, backend and cloud architecture. Mendoza, Argentina.

hero.title: Software development as a strategic decision
hero.subtitle: We align technology, product and business to create real impact. We design, build and evolve the software that powers startups and companies.

services.title: Our services
services.subtitle: We cover the full lifecycle of a digital product: from idea to launch, and from launch to scale.

productDesign.title: Product Design
productDesign.description: Discovery, UX/UI and prototyping to launch products people actually use.

mobile.title: Mobile apps
mobile.description: iOS and Android apps with React Native: one codebase, native experience.

web.title: Web development
web.description: Fast, secure and scalable websites and platforms, built with React and Next.js.

backend.title: Backend development
backend.description: Robust APIs and systems in Node.js, Go and Python that power your day-to-day operations.

infra.title: Architecture & infrastructure
infra.description: Cloud, DevOps and AWS architectures designed to grow without friction or surprises.

cases.title: Results that speak for us
cases.subtitle: We work as technology partners. These are some of the products we built together with our clients.

rentennials.name: Rentennials
rentennials.challenge: Turning peer-to-peer car rental into a fully digital experience: listings, bookings, payments and trust between users in one place.
rentennials.solution: We built the web platform and the admin panel: vehicle listings, booking management and operations tooling for the team.
rentennials.result: A live marketplace connecting owners and drivers, with centralized operations ready to scale.

taker.name: Taker
taker.challenge: Turning a business vision into a working digital product under demanding time-to-market constraints.
taker.solution: We assembled a dedicated product and engineering team that took Taker from UX/UI design to launch, iterating on real user feedback.
taker.result: A product in production that keeps evolving alongside the business.

sinustrack.name: SinusTrack
sinustrack.challenge: Digitizing patient follow-up: scattered clinical information and manual communication between professionals and patients.
sinustrack.solution: We developed the web portal for professionals and a WhatsApp assistant that automates patient contact and follow-up.
sinustrack.result: Centralized follow-up and automated communication, with less operational load for the medical team.

invertironline.name: InvertirOnline
invertironline.challenge: Adding engineering capacity to one of Argentina's leading investment platforms, in a demanding, regulated environment.
invertironline.solution: Our team joined the development of their digital products, bringing delivery speed with enterprise-grade quality standards.
invertironline.result: Consistent delivery on a platform used by hundreds of thousands of investors.

process.title: We are more than code
process.intro: At Kairox we work as technology partners for startups and companies, taking part in key product, architecture and technology decisions.

understand.title: We design from understanding
understand.description: We analyze the context, the business and the users to identify real problems. Technical decisions are born from the problem to solve, not from the tool of the day.

build.title: We build solid software, made to grow
build.description: We develop with a focus on quality, scalability and real-world use. We take care of every detail so it works today and can grow tomorrow.

evolve.title: Software doesn't end at launch
evolve.description: We measure, adjust and improve continuously, supporting the evolution of the software and the product over time.

team.title: The people behind Kairox
team.subtitle: A multidisciplinary team combining development, design and software architecture, working as one team alongside every client.

tech.title: World-class tooling
